trajectory_contract.world_gauge_condition: The benchmark FAST-LIVO2 launch uses agt_mapping mid360_lio_only.yaml with uav.gravity_align_en=true.
evidence: LiDAR points are transformed by LiDAR-to-IMU extrinsics before _state.rot_end/_state.pos_end, so the published state is the IMU/body state.
FAST-LIVO2 IMU initialization starts rot_end at identity and estimates gravity; gravityAlignment rotates the state so gravity points along global -Z when enabled.

benchmark_notes: Primary reference. FAST-LIVO2 names its configured transform Lid_*_to_IMU, so the benchmark adapter declares LIDAR_TO_IMU. Record the effective modality set per run; LiDAR-IMU-only runs are not labeled visual. Adapter PASS reflects the recorded green-house full-bag verification, not universal dataset compatibility. For the current green-house benchmark launch, the world gauge is gravity-aligned; a non-level handheld start is therefore expected to appear as non-zero initial roll/pitch.
